objective: A frozen exploratory test, exact: under the doubling law every P = 1, 2, 3, 4 lags from the 3 x 3 tube at g = 2 to 24 x 24, four birth rules for every cell a doubling bears (open, copy of the cell it splits from, zero, open plus copy); at each doubling lag, whether every stage is balanced, whether every contact still binds every ring older than the doubling, and how many own cells hear another ring; hypotheses frozen in the contract.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-09 (exploratory, exact; frozen contract): under the doubling law every P = 1 to 4 lags from 3 x 3 at g = 2, copy and zero births leave every stage unbalanced (new rings bear no distinction; H1); open reproduces the control (H3); open plus copy keeps every stage balanced while rings hear each other through 12 x 12 at P = 1 (H2 and, narrowly, H4 refuted) and fails at 24 x 24 at every P; no rule sustains balance with hearing, so A44 stands for growth that keeps going.
title: Birth rules for the doubling law: a frozen test of A44
